_about: The music edit. Source: assets/music/tonisound-happy-christmas-ukulelefull-version-178942.mp3. Tempo and grid from scripts/audio/analyze-music.py: 110.0 BPM, 4/4, key B major (chords B, D#m, F#, E in a 4-bar cycle). Video bar n starts at v0Seconds + n * barSeconds, less introDropBeats beats from video bar 2 on: the light intro is 3.5 bars, its last bar (E) cut to 2 beats before the groove, so 01 is 6 beats long and every later cut stays on a downbeat. Every splice keeps the chord cycle, repeats a chord (D#m into the breakdown, under the push into the slip) or lands on a cadence (E, F#, B at the end), so none is heard as a jump.
